newsitem.title: USA: Tosco Calif. refinery units said at 100 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tosco Calif. refinery units said at 100 pct.

text.p: Operations at Tosco Corp's 156,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery in Avon, Calif., returned to normal over the weekend following unplanned shutdowns of units earlier this month, industry sources said on Tuesday.

The plant's 66,000 bpd catalytic cracking unit, which helps make gasoline, had shut for a day earlier this month, while a 32,000 bpd hydrocracking unit was shut for about 10 days starting around August 4, sources said.
"They're back and operating at 100 percent," an industry source said.
Tosco officials were not immediately available for comment.
